test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The food was too salty __eat__ this morning.
solution:
The correct answer is: **to eat**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the correct form of the verb 'to eat' is appropriate.
 
• The sentence structure requires an **infinitive **form '**to eat'** after the adjective **too salty**.
 
• Therefore, the correct form of the verb 'to eat' should be used in place of the incorrect form 'eat'.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *The food was too salty **to eat** this morning*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• If the **sentence structure requires an infinitive verb** after an adjective, always use the infinitive form 'to + verb'.

 
 
• **Example:** *The task was too difficult **to complete** in one day*.
 
 
 
• Ensure that the verb form matches the grammatical requirements of the sentence structure.
 
 
• Example: *The movie was too boring **to watch** until the end*.
